description: R08 functional-debt checkpoint: close the effective TIL RunLengthEncodingTests family through the existing safe Rle owner plus portable variable-length sequence transformations and direct Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: Safe Rust reproduces default-empty state and insertion into an initially empty RLE sequence.
Explicit runs are expanded and canonicalized with the same logical values and run boundaries as Microsoft's initializer-list vector.
The existing Rle indexed-access owner reproduces all Microsoft run-boundary positions and out-of-range behavior.
Portable slicing covers empty, full, between-run and within-run boundaries and returns canonical RLE output.
The direct witness reproduces Microsoft's full 29-vector remove/insert/replace/neighbor-merge matrix with variable-length replacements.
Value replacement preserves unaffected values and merges newly adjacent equal runs for all six Microsoft vectors.
Shrinking preserves every tested prefix and growth repeats the trailing value exactly as basic_rle does.
Expanded safe-Rust iteration reproduces forward/reverse values, random positions and iterator-distance observables without copying C++ iterator representation.
